scenario_description: A zero-exit component cannot pass when its JSON artifact violates its output contract.
expected: Source and adapter steps complete against their exact contracts.
The broken sink exits zero and its complete stdout is retained.
Draft 2020-12 validation rejects the sink artifact and all_steps_completed remains false.
observed: The final solver module hash was retained; the source and paper-title-to-document-name adapter completed first and their artifacts passed paper-record/v1 and document-record/v1.
The deliberately broken sink was the file referenced by argv, matched its separate lock before and after execution, exited zero, and retained stdout omitting report.title and trace.source.
Draft 2020-12 validation retained two concrete errors at /report and /trace, marked the sink step failed, kept all_steps_completed false, and assigned no raw verdict despite the green process exit.
notes: PASS applies to detection of the deliberate artifact defect. It is not a passing verdict for the broken sink or a production-readiness claim for the generated calibration bundle.
